source: the model header (Trace conformance) and its SigmaObs/H definitions
hidden: H = diff(Events, SigmaObs): decisions without record, offers, comm, pend_done updates and checks, flag sets and waits, stale flags
projection: one rendezvous channel used only by plain operations: its WaitChannel records, their Resume (the same thread's next Resume), its RendezvousDone

configurations.name: SYS (lazy)
requires: one plain writer thread and one plain reader thread, different
no Alternative guard on the channel

stable_failures.X: all of SigmaObs (nothing is awaited from the environment); lazy sides may be busy elsewhere

gaps: serial semaphore waits and pair waits record the same events
more than one writer or reader: the serial semaphore matters, not modelled
